_comment: Single source of truth for every trained MLP variant, loaded and resolved by scripts/mlp_variants.py. JSON has no comment syntax, so '_'-prefixed keys are notes only, ignored by the loader. 'class_groups_base' must be 'CLASS_GROUPS' (original 6-class taxonomy) or 'MLP_CLASS_GROUPS' (standing 5-class, bus merged into large_vehicle) - both are resolved against the real dicts in dataloader.py, never duplicated here, so the taxonomy mapping itself always has exactly one source of truth. 'class_groups_overrides' (optional) merges on top of that base for a variant that needs one class to diverge, e.g. truck_separate. 'output_dir' is relative to MLP_DIR (results/mlp/); null means MLP_DIR itself, the standing baseline. 'features'/'extra_features' (optional) override mlp_classifier.py's own feature-set defaults. 'run_kwargs' (optional) overrides its hyperparameter defaults (epochs/batch_size/lr/hidden_dim).

baseline._note: Current working model: bus merged into large_vehicle, Design_Decisions.md decision 1's final resolution. Lives at MLP_DIR, mlp_classifier.py's own default.

bus_separate._note: Original, pre-merge taxonomy (bus kept separate). Kept for reference/comparison, not the standing model anymore.

epochs_1000._note: Ablation that informed the merge decision (MLP_Decisions_and_Findings.md section 2): 1000 epochs instead of 50, no meaningful gain past ~150-200.

truck_separate._note: Ablation that informed the merge decision (section 4): un-merges truck too, confirms decision 1's truck merge was correct.

bs32._note: Re-checks BATCH_SIZE=128 now that bus is merged: two_wheeler (7.0%) only needs bs=32, unlike bus's original 1.9%. Found no real difference (section 5).

range_sc._note: Swaps the feature set: range_sc binned like the other point-level features, in place of doppler_spread appended unbinned. Looked better, confirmed noise (section 5).

hidden8._note: Capacity ablation (section 6): HIDDEN_DIM=8 vs standing 16. No effect, even per-class.

hidden32._note: Capacity ablation (section 6): HIDDEN_DIM=32 vs standing 16. No effect, even per-class.

hidden64._note: Capacity ablation (section 6): HIDDEN_DIM=64 vs standing 16. No effect, even per-class.
